system.story: Seizes the fixed systems - doors, cameras, turrets - to shape the battlefield.

description.value:
Subclass: Controller - the Sysop. Seizes the fixed systems - doors, cameras, turrets, elevators, environmental controls - to shape the battlefield and lock the enemy out of it. The map-controller.

Role Feature - Master Key

You count facility fixed-systems as already partly compromised: your first Intrusion each encounter against a building system is at an edge, and Lockdown costs you 1 less Bandwidth.

Signature Tweak

Cascade also seals or opens all linked doors in the affected net.

Bonus Skill & Contact

Security Systems, plus a facilities/maintenance or corp-insider contact.

Chrome Flavor

A stable, high-persistence deck tuned for holding many nodes at once.
